        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();

                applyGuard();

                clearGuard();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>
<h4>September 2021 - September 2026 Meetings</h4>
<p>(Meetings <strong>before September 2021</strong> are listed in the Minutes & Agenda Archive, below the current listing)</p>

                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>
<h4>September 2021 - September 2026 Meetings</h4>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>
<h4>September 2021 - September 2026 Meetings</h4>
<p>(Meetings <strong>before September 2021</strong> are listed in the Minutes & Agenda Archive, below the current listing)</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>
<h4>September 2021 - September 2026 Meetings</h4>
<p>(Meetings <strong>before September 2021</strong> are listed in the Minutes & Agenda Archive, below the current listing)</p>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {

                }

                    return;
                }

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>
<h4>September 2021 - September 2026 Meetings</h4>
<p>(Meetings <strong>before September 2021</strong> are listed in the Minutes & Agenda Archive, below the current listing)</p>

                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings - Agenda & Minutes</h1>

<p>Regular meetings of Council are scheduled for the <strong>last Tuesday in every month</strong>, unless that Tuesday falls on a public holiday and in December, where the meeting is held in the middle of the month. Council may also call <strong>additional</strong>, unscheduled meetings, to enable it to discuss and decide upon specific matters. </p>
<p>Members of the public can attend Council meetings in person (293 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley).</p>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1">If you would like to have a question answered at the meeting, please <strong>submit your question</strong> by 4pm on the working day before the Council meeting (usually the Monday before the Tuesday night meeting). For more information, visit <a href="https://www.monash.vic.gov.au/About-Us/Council/Council-Meetings/Public-Question-Time">public question time</a>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Live-streaming of Council meetings</strong> - visit: <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video.php" target="_blank">webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/video</a></p>
<p><strong>The videos of our February 2017 - September 2026</strong> <strong>meetings</strong> are available on the <a href="http://webcast.monash.vic.gov.au/archive.php" target="_blank">archive page</a>.</p>
